title: Rupture
description: Whenever you lose HP on your turn, gain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold].
smart_description: Whenever you lose HP on your turn, gain [blue]{Amount}[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold].
notes: Rupture gains Strength whenever the player loses HP during their turn. If damage comes from a card the player played this turn, the Strength gain is applied after that card finishes resolving. Otherwise, Strength is applied immediately.
